<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child*)>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent "Parsed Entity Content">
  <?target-pi data="processing instruction value"?>
  <!-- Root level structural comment -->
]>
<root xmlns="http://www.example.com/ns/root" xmlns:sub="http://www.example.com/ns/sub" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Comment inside namespace context -->
  <?sub:pi attr="value"?>
  <sub:child xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing <tags>, &entities;, and "quotes" inside xmlns context.
    ]]>
    &ent;
  </sub:child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (section+)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % paramEnt "<!ELEMENT nested (#PCDATA)>">
  %paramEnt;
  <!ENTITY baseEnt "Base Entity">
  <!ENTITY refEnt "&baseEnt; Extended">
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
  <!-- DTD-level comment -->
]>
<doc xmlns="http://doc.org/ns" xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <!-- Document body comment -->
  <?pi-target data="test"?>
  <section xmlns:custom="http://doc.org/ns/custom">
    <![CDATA[
      Nested CDATA with markup: <section> &refEnt; </section>
    ]]>
    <custom:item>&refEnt;</custom:item>
  </section>
</doc>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (book*)>
  <!ELEMENT book (title, author)>
  <!ELEMENT title (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT author (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY pub "Global Publishing Inc.">
  <!ENTITY copyright "Copyright &pub; All rights reserved.">
  <?catalog-info version="2.0" status="active"?>
  <!-- Catalog DTD declaration comment -->
]>
<catalog xmlns="http://schema.org/catalog" xmlns:m="http://schema.org/meta" xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/">
  <!-- Catalog root comment -->
  <m:metadata>
    <?m:processor mode="strict"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Metadata block with CDATA & copyright info: ©right;
    ]]>
  </m:metadata>
  <book xmlns:b="http://schema.org/book">
    <title>&pub; Guide</title>
    <author>Jane Doe</author>
  </book>
</catalog>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (header, body)>
  <!ELEMENT header (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT body (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY e1 "Entity One">
  <!ENTITY e2 "Entity Two &e1;">
  <!ENTITY e3 "Entity Three &e2;">
  <?doc-info author="Tester" date="2023-10-01"?>
  <!-- Document DTD comment block -->
]>
<document xmlns="http://xml.org/document" xmlns:ext="http://xml.org/document/ext" xmlns:xhtml="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml">
  <!-- Header comment -->
  <header>
    <?ext:action run="true"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Header CDATA with special symbols: <xml> &e3; </xml>
    ]]>
  </header>
  <body xmlns:html="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml">
    <html:div>&e3;</html:div>
  </body>
</document>
```

<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY code "ABC-12345">
  <!ENTITY desc "Description for &code;">
  <?inventory-mgmt system="automated" priority="high"?>
  <!-- Inventory schema definition comment -->
]>
<inventory xmlns="http://inventory.org/ns" xmlns:store="http://inventory.org/store" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Inventory root comment -->
  <store:warehouse location="North">
    <?store:audit status="pending" validator="sys-admin"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Warehouse CDATA containing entity reference string: &desc;
    ]]>
    <store:product xlink:title="Product">&desc;</store:product>
  </store:warehouse>
</inventory>
